description: This file contains functions for quantization conversions in PyTorch, including packing and unpacking int4 values, and reordering quantized weight tensors for optimized matrix operations on CUDA devices.

methods.name: pack_int4_to_int8
methods.description: Pack pairs of int4 values into an int8 tensor in row-major order.

methods.name: unpack_int8_to_int4
methods.description: Unpack an int8 tensor into pairs of int4 values.

methods.name: quantized_weight_reorder_for_mixed_dtypes_linear_cutlass
methods.description: Reorder and transpose quantized weight tensors for use with CUTLASS library, supporting different data types and transposition options.
